raw: I had mushroom risotto for dinner last night, with peas folded into the rice and grated Parmesan sprinkled on top. The Parmesan is the first thing that comes to mind, then the little green peas among the rice and mushrooms. It’s funny how remembering one part brings the others back. I’m an amateur stargazer, and I do that with the sky too—notice one thing, then start looking around it. But the meal itself, yes, it was mushroom risotto.
